Privacy Policy — Kirana Mart

Effective date: May 16, 2026 Last updated: May 16, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Kirana Mart ("we", "our", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our mobile application ("the App").

If you have any questions, contact us at: sudhir.davim@gmail.com

1. Who we are

Kirana Mart is a mobile application that connects customers with local kirana (grocery) shops in India, with optional delivery via independent delivery partners. The App is currently operated by Sudhir Davim. Kirana Mart is in beta and not yet available to the general public.

2. Information we collect

We collect the minimum information necessary to provide the App's core functionality.

2.1 Account and profile information

When you create an account or use the App, we collect:

  • Phone number — required for sign-in via OTP (one-time password). This is your account identifier.
  • Name (optional) — used on order receipts and to address you in the App.
  • Email address (optional) — used to send order receipts and important account notifications.

2.2 Address information

When you place an order or save an address for future use, we collect:

  • Recipient name, phone, and delivery address (line 1, line 2, city, pincode) — used to deliver your order.

You may save multiple addresses in your profile. You may delete any saved address at any time from the Profile screen.

2.3 Order information

We collect and retain:

  • Order contents (items, quantities, prices)
  • Payment method (Cash on Delivery or online payment via Razorpay) and payment status
  • Delivery status and timestamps (accepted, prepared, picked up, delivered)
  • Shop and delivery partner identifiers associated with your order

2.4 Device and technical information

We collect:

  • Approximate location — used only to show you nearby shops. If you decline location access, the App falls back to a default location and continues to work.
  • Device push notification token — used to send you order status updates (when your order is accepted, ready, out for delivery, and delivered). Stored on our servers and removed when you delete the App.
  • Crash and performance data — anonymized, used to fix bugs.

2.5 What we do NOT collect

  • We do not collect or store your payment card or bank account details. All payment information is collected directly by our payment processor (Razorpay) and is never sent to or stored by us.
  • We do not collect biometric data (Face ID, fingerprint).
  • We do not access your contacts, photos, microphone, or camera.
  • We do not track your activity across other apps or websites.

3. How we use your information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Authenticate your identity via phone OTP
  • Show you nearby shops and their menus
  • Process your orders and route them to the appropriate shop and delivery partner
  • Send you order status notifications
  • Provide customer support if you contact us
  • Diagnose technical problems and improve the App
  • Comply with legal obligations

We do not use your information for advertising, marketing campaigns, or sale to third parties.

4. Who we share your information with

We share information only with the service providers necessary to operate the App. These providers are contractually bound to use the information only for the services they provide to us.

Service providerPurposeData shared
Google (Firebase)Authentication, database, cloud functions, file storageAccount, profile, order, device data
RazorpayPayment processingOrder amount, your name and phone for payment receipts
Expo (Expo Application Services)Push notification deliveryYour device push token and notification content
SentryCrash reporting and error monitoringAnonymized crash data, device model, OS version

We may share information with:

  • Shop owners — your name, phone, and delivery address for orders you place at their shop, so they can prepare and arrange delivery
  • Delivery partners — your name, phone, and delivery address for orders assigned to them, so they can complete delivery. The phone number is only shown after they accept your order
  • Government authorities — when required by law or legal process in India

We do not sell your personal information to third parties under any circumstances.

5. Data retention

  • Account data is retained while your account is active. You may request deletion at any time by emailing sudhir.davim@gmail.com.
  • Order history is retained for at least 3 years after the order date, for tax and regulatory reasons under Indian law.
  • Saved addresses are retained until you delete them.
  • Anonymized crash/performance data is retained for up to 90 days.

6. Your rights

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India) and similar regulations, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you
  • Correct inaccurate information (via the Profile screen, or by contacting us)
  • Delete your account and associated personal information (we will retain order history as required by law, but anonymize it)
  • Withdraw consent for any optional data collection (e.g. location). Withdrawing consent may limit some App functionality

To exercise these rights, email sudhir.davim@gmail.com. We will respond within 30 days.

7. Security

We use industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including:

  • Encrypted data transmission (HTTPS / TLS)
  • Server-side authentication and authorization checks
  • Restricted access to personal data by our team and service providers

No system is perfectly secure. We will notify you promptly if we become aware of a data breach that affects your personal information.

8. Children's privacy

Kirana Mart is not intended for users under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us at sudhir.davim@gmail.com and we will delete it promptly.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this policy. For significant changes, we will notify users via the App or via email.

10. Contact us

For any questions about this Privacy Policy, or to exercise your rights, contact us at:

Email: sudhir.davim@gmail.com

This policy is provided for the Kirana Mart beta program. It will be updated for general availability with additional disclosures required by Apple App Store, Google Play, and other distribution channels.
